question: National Tribal Dance Festival 2022 was held in which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raipur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Tribal Dance Festival 2022 was held in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.**
 
• The festival was organized by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• **The aim of the festival was to showcase the rich cultural heritage of tribal communities from across the country.**
 
• The festival featured various dance forms such as **Gond, Santhali, Warli,** and many others.
 
• **The festival also provided a platform for tribal artists to interact with each other and exchange ideas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jaipur is the capital of the Indian state of Rajasthan and is known for its rich history, culture, and architecture.**

 
 
• It is also known as the **"Pink City"** due to the color of its buildings.
 
 
 
• **Pune **is a city in the western Indian state of** Maharashtra.**
 
 
• It is known for its** educational institutions, IT industry,** and cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Puri** is a coastal town in the eastern Indian state of **Odisha**.
 
 
• It is known for the **Jagannath Temple,** which is one of the four major Hindu pilgrimage sites.
